items.headline: Regional grid operators publish new vendor reliability checklist
items.summary: A new checklist emphasizes audit trails, incident response windows, and vendor continuity plans for software touching grid operations.
items.whyItMatters: EnergyCo's commercial review includes procurement and security. Lead with auditability and response process, not speed alone.

items.headline: AsterFlow ships workflow cards for developer task automation
items.summary: AsterFlow announced reusable workflow cards that bundle prompts, tools, and validation steps for software teams.
items.whyItMatters: This directly affects Tuesday's LaunchLens roadmap review. Workflow cards are no longer theoretical; a competitor has planted the category.

items.headline: Growth investors push harder on expansion revenue in 2026 SaaS updates
items.summary: Recent investor notes are weighting expansion revenue, renewal quality, and usage-based retention more heavily than new-logo growth.
items.whyItMatters: Ari specifically wants to pressure-test expansion narrative and net retention in Wednesday's dry run.

items.headline: Developers ask for prebuilt workflow templates in automation tools
items.summary: Community posts over the weekend favored template libraries and validation checklists over blank-canvas automation builders.
items.whyItMatters: The DevRel digest says users are asking for templates. Pair that with competitor workflow cards in the product review.
